# About this thesis

This is the landing page for {{user.name}}'s dissertation, "{{thesis.workingTitle}}",
at {{institution.name}} ({{institution.degreeProgram}}).

The thesis is rendered via Quarto + LuaLaTeX to a PDF whenever you push changes
to `ui/www/` or `R/`; a stable copy is committed to `docs/thesis.pdf` by the
`build-thesis.yml` workflow.

**Read it:** [the thesis PDF](thesis.pdf) (latest CI build) · [the R package
reference](r-package.qmd) (functions, rendered from the roxygen docs).
